basis: Own fixed equal-weight preparation controls; not an official PyPA score or publication authorization
formula: 100 * PASS / 20; each control is 5 points; blocked/partial/unknown receive zero and retain denominator

criteria.initial_evidence: Pyprojects y READMEs del par A13

criteria.definition: Identidades y versiones del par coherentes entre fuentes y artefactos
criteria.initial_evidence: Recibo de calidad A13, hashes y metadatos

criteria.definition: Backend/herramientas de construcción fijados y comandos repetibles
criteria.initial_evidence: `hatchling==1.28.0`, locks, guías de construcción

criteria.definition: Metadata técnica, Python, extras y entry points válidos
criteria.initial_evidence: Pyprojects, METADATA, pruebas de distribución; licencia se mide en P17

criteria.definition: Dependencias de instalación sin rutas del autor/repos privados
criteria.initial_evidence: Requires-Dist; benchmark exige exactamente el núcleo A13

criteria.definition: Archivos y hashes del par identificados y conservados para entrega

criteria.initial_evidence: Falta expediente conjunto del par con los nuevos controles de contenido

criteria.definition: Consulta fechada de ambos nombres en PyPI/TestPyPI y sus límites
criteria.initial_evidence: No hay observación actual del índice vinculada a esta preparación

criteria.definition: Titulares y licencia aprobados, archivos/notices/metadata incluidos en nuevas distribuciones
criteria.initial_evidence: El usuario indicó que todavía no dispone de esa decisión

criteria.initial_evidence: No hay recibo de cuenta/control; una consulta no reserva nombres

criteria.initial_evidence: Repositorio privado; links actuales requieren acceso

criteria.definition: Par realmente subido a TestPyPI e instalado desde ese índice con hashes coincidentes
criteria.initial_evidence: No existe publicación de ensayo ni autorización/licencia que la habilite

local_recovery_drill.scope: Supplied local mappings only; no upload, authenticated index result, actual withdrawal/yank or installed rollback executed in this drill.

public_index_observations.limitation: Public JSON listings only; 404 does not establish availability, account control or reservation.

pending_decisions_unchanged: Owner must choose the distribution channel and approve public disclosure.
Owner must approve the project license and redistribution terms; no license is assigned.
Owner must assign release and vulnerability-response responsibility and a verified private reporting channel.
Complete STEP10 and the separately requested global review before any public release.
Confirm names, public documentation access, account ownership and publication protections in a separately authorized task.
Review exact artifact-bound dependency licenses, current vulnerability evidence and source-security findings; unresolved or unavailable checks are blockers.
Authorize publication of the exact version and artifact hashes after all gates pass.
external_steps_to_90: Complete at least two of P17-P20 with actual owner-approved rights/accounts/public access/index execution; all publication gates remain mandatory
limitations: Local byte/inventory checks are not rights, name/account ownership or human approval
No network, extraction, candidate-code execution, signing, token access or upload
Filename inventory cannot prove absence of every embedded secret or private content
Historical execution receipts must be separately reviewed; no new full-suite or TestPyPI result
Recovery mappings are local supplied simulations, not authenticated index observations or actual yank/rollback
New README is proposed root text, not delivered A13 METADATA
Root changes are preparation in a private Git repository, not a public package release

navigation.limits: Offline explicit scope; inline/reference Markdown links and ATX/setext heading IDs. No general renderer equivalence, HTML href audit, remote availability or human review.
